method: Assistant-authored conversational Unslop Full using supplied installed 0.7.0 guidance; no humanize.py, CLI or API execution. Separate post-rewrite audit by the same assistant, not an external independent reviewer.
preserved_catalog_fields: Every field except intro, why and tradeoff: exact identity/variant, dimensions, movement, strap, facts, ASIN/search, source and popularity URLs/notes/dates, image URL/alt and selection label.

preserved: All navigation/link/button names: concise action labels or exact model names.
Consent panel, choices, status messages and privacy policy: Auto-Clarity and exact enabled behavior.
Filter/search states, results counts and image-unavailable text: concise functional labels.
Disclosure and legal footer: required disclosure and literal qualifications.
Eyebrows, headings, product labels and alternative text: protected headings/names or concise descriptive text.

other_preserved_copy: Guide light-powered operation and crystal paragraph: already concrete technical explanation.
Popular collection methods: manufacturer sources, October 13, 2026 date, retained 2025 source-heading caveat, editorial order and no Amazon-ranking claim.
Comparison quick verdict, choice cards, specifications, diagram explanation, timed-routine criterion, water-use guidance and source note: precise comparison or Auto-Clarity.
Home and hub live-price/research qualifications: accurate disclosure.
excluded: Legacy root index.html and deals.json: not active build inputs or deployed pages.
Search Console ownership HTML: exact verification bytes, not editorial content.
Internal planning and historical release documents: not live site copy; no new campaign-policy conclusions or release claims.
findings_addressed: Removed unsupported SRE004 market-prevalence phrase: a size often dominated by quartz watches. No replacement market claim.
Removed SSB429 generalized steel-versus-rubber versatility claim; framed bracelet preference as reader choice.
Restored literal water-use qualifications under Auto-Clarity.
Preserved uncertainty about appearance, stopping after time unworn and radio reception.
Clarified F-91W 21 grams as watch weight, not case-only weight.
Corrected missing conjunction in About non-endorsement sentence.
limits: Checks compare prose with existing manufacturer-linked records and the original source copy; manufacturer pages were not re-fetched and research dates were not advanced.
No live price, inventory, sales or current bestseller-rank validation.
No Amazon links activated and no real conversion requested.
Deployment/browser verification is recorded separately from these local source checks.
